summary: Iteration 234 — Katrina (كاترينا) axios-migration regression. Validated that the platform's rrweb fetch-interception bugs ('stream ended without done event' / 'Body is disturbed or locked' / 'تعذّر الاتصال بالمساعد' / 'فشل التنفيذ') no longer appear after sendMessage and handleExecute were switched from fetch to axios. Frontend 10/10 critical checks PASS. Three regression questions (open visits, top-3 debtors, financial health) all received assistant replies with NO error bubbles. EXEC-via-send (customer 'ماجد التجريبي') returned the proper duplicate-detection bubble (⚠️ عميل موجود مسبقاً — already created in iteration 233) without any error. EXEC-via-🚀-button created a NEW vehicle (plate 9911 تويوتا كورولا 2020, id c8be305d-d5e5-4132-9dac-14076fea4287) with '✅ تم بنجاح' and NO 'Body is disturbed or locked'. Multi-turn follow-up works. Mobile drawer height = 0.800 vh. Close button + FAB return verified. Voice toggle + mic button render. Note: console still emits 'JWT login error: TypeError: Failed to fetch' from the emergent-main.js / rrweb pre-load injection — this is the original rrweb-fetch lock surfacing for the platform's own analytics call, NOT inside our app's assistant path — confirms exactly why the axios switch was necessary; our app paths are unaffected.

issues: Platform's emergent-main.js fires 'JWT login error: TypeError: Failed to fetch' due to rrweb-recorder wrapping window.fetch and locking the body. This is the SAME root cause described in the user's bug report. Our app no longer hits it because all assistant/runtime calls now use axios. The emergent-main.js call itself is not under our control — recommend the platform team apply the same axios switch or have rrweb skip wrapping for /api/* requests.
Still emits React validateDOMNesting warning: <button> nested inside <button>. Carried over from iteration 233 — unchanged.

rca of the issue: Verified RCA from main agent: rrweb session-recorder wraps window.fetch, locking/disturbing the response body for any fetch-based caller. The previous SSE chat (fetch + ReadableStream) and the 🚀 execute (fetch) both hit this lock on real mobile devices where rrweb loads. Fix applied by main agent: switch both paths to axios (XMLHttpRequest under the hood — NOT subject to fetch-wrapping). Verification this iteration: 0 occurrences of any of the 4 error bubble strings across 3 questions + 2 execute paths + 1 multi-turn follow-up = 6 flows. Mitigation effective.
